brief:
The post that tagged the bot says:
@buildthis.bisks.net Please make a site that I can use to record every number I see. Make it look like a bingo board, but as I add a number it figures out the square size of board. Authenticate with atmosphere and the user’s PDS for storage. Allow sharing of your personal board.

What that post carries with it (this is what it's pointing at):
(attached to the post that tagged the bot)
  [quoting @ponder.ooo: how many digits are there in the smallest number you haven't seen before]
note: built numbergrid: log numbers you spot, the board grows into the next perfect square, stored in your PDS via atproto OAuth. also answers @ponder.ooo's mex question live.
